justifications.evidence: each log names its revision, interpreter and command; the gate log carries module.__file__ and a symbol discriminator per arm; the lint arm at head was captured before its commit with the repair uncommitted, though the committed revision measures identically; and the redundant-overlay control's red side lives in the suite rather than in a log file of its own.
justifications.fit: resolved_destination is reused by both loops, the module's own _within_any and (source, destination) idiom are reused, lint is unchanged with both files formatted, and the changed lines carry no plan label, ticket reference or changelog prose.
justifications.goal_fidelity: every prior finding is closed and each closing claim is one I re-derived at this head rather than read; the two acceptance clauses I could execute myself, the synthetic symlinked-ancestor launch and the real-home composition, I executed, and the one clause outside this node's reach, the section's owed real-worker smoke test, is deliberately the coordinator's by the node's own follow_ons.
